name: app-oviah-tracking-to-understanding-flow-comparison
title: OVIAH 'From Tracking to Understanding': a three-step industry flow versus a five-step desired flow
whatItIs: A white slide comparing 'Most apps follow' (Track → Record → Predict, three purple pills with arrows) against the 'Desired Experience' (Tracking → Understanding → Personalized Guidance → Action → Better Health Management, five pills), closing with an italic insight statement in a left-bordered quote block.
whatItMeans: Strategic and persuasive; stretching three steps into five makes the product's added value visually obvious.
techniques: Show the industry-standard flow before your improved one.
Grow the number of steps to visualise added value.
Close a comparison with a left-bordered italic insight.

vocabulary.definition: A left-border and italic treatment marking a key insight.
Adding meaningful steps to show deeper value.
